game_start.intro: O joko omanuka. Mufuka wa ngola: {trump_suit} (karta ya ngola: {trump_str}).
game_start.no_trump_card: ki muala kima kia difu ni kiki.

player_prompt.intro:
Nge o Mwana-jôgo {player_id} mu Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Nge una mikanda {hand_size}.
Teka mikanda na '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake mu maboko enu (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: FAZA YA KUJIFUNZA: o mfunge wa kila kipande akota kipande kya kufua na o mfunge wa kushindwa akota kipande kijerumani kutoka kwa sitaha. Mikanda inayoshinda mu faza hii haikuhesabiwa kwa ushindi.
player_prompt.phase_playing: FAZA YA KUTWANA: sitaha imekauka. Kila kipande kuanzia sasa kinahesabiwa kwa ushindi.

next_card.playing_phase: O kitambuijilu kiki, ki moneka kala kia kidi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O kijimbuete kia mukuá, mu phutu a k'ixana "[play N]". Phala kulondekesa o kaxa ia dikuinhi ku lukuaku luê.
invalid_move.bad_position: O kididi kiki, ki kia kidi. Eie uala ni {hand_size} dia jimapa.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Nge lazima ufuate kipande kya kufua na uteke kipande {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: O kitambuijilu kiki ki tena ku kala kia kidi.

trick.won_learning: Mwana-jôgo {winner_id} ashinda kipande na {card} na akota kipande kya kufua.

phase.learning_complete: O athu ka tena dingi ku bhanga kima, kioso kia zubha o ku di longa o ima ioso ia lungu ni maka enhá.

draw.winner_received: Eie ua nganhala o kikoué, eie u tambula {card}.
draw.loser_received: Eie ua jimbi o kitambuijilu kiê, eie ua solo {card} mu kijimbuete kia tokala.

turn.scores_learning: Mikanda inayoshinda mpaka sasa - Mwana-jôgo 0: {tricks0}, Mwana-jôgo 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Ki ngala ni kalatá ka salu bhu maku'ami.

trick_view.empty: O kuila o ku bhanga kiki, kua-nda tu kuatekesa?

board_str.blank: {observation} O ku di longa o Bibidia.

outcome.summary: Faza ya kujifunza - Mwana-jôgo 0: {l0}, Mwana-jôgo 1: {l1}. Faza ya kutwana - Mwana-jôgo 0: {p0}, Mwana-jôgo 1: {p1}. Mwana-jôgo {winner_id} ashinda na {winner_tricks} mikanda inayohesabiwa!
